metadata.description: Foundry for Claude Code — a senior-engineering agent stack: research, development, quality, ops, PMO, economics, legal, OSS governance, with governed memory and token economy.

plugins.name: foundry-core
plugins.description: Kernel: governed memory, token economy, I/O contracts, orchestration, guard hooks and the Foundry MCP server. Required by every other Foundry plugin.

plugins.name: foundry-research
plugins.description: Domain research, technical discovery, documentation engineering and public docs for open source projects.

plugins.name: foundry-dev
plugins.description: Senior engineering: architecture, functional design, protocols, security, integrations, UX/a11y, Angular, Spring Boot, databases, API and service versioning.

plugins.name: foundry-quality
plugins.description: Test strategy, TDD enforcement, contract and E2E testing, performance engineering, observability and SRE practice.

plugins.name: foundry-ai
plugins.description: AI engineering: retrieval pipelines measured on labelled query sets, LLM evaluation with calibrated judges, prompt engineering as versioned code, and agent tool and loop design.

plugins.name: foundry-data
plugins.description: Data science and classical ML: exploratory analysis, feature engineering and model training, evaluation, and production ML operations.

plugins.name: foundry-ops
plugins.description: Delivery and deploy: GitHub Actions pipelines, containers and Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, cloud and PaaS targets, release engineering.

plugins.name: foundry-pmo
plugins.description: PMO and agile delivery: roadmaps, backlog, requirements, risk, Scrum events, flow metrics and forecasting, and tracker operations across GitHub, Jira, Linear and GitLab.

plugins.name: foundry-economics
plugins.description: Project cost engineering, business cases and financial plans, AI/token cost control, grant and public funding reporting.

plugins.name: foundry-legal
plugins.description: Compliance engine with pluggable jurisdiction packs: global baseline, EU/Italy, North America, UK/APAC/LATAM, plus OSS licensing and IP.

plugins.name: foundry-growth
plugins.description: Everything around the project rather than inside it: positioning and messaging, launch and audience, fundraising narrative and funder targeting, personal reputation, and finding collaborators in your own field.

plugins.name: foundry-oss
plugins.description: Open source governance: contribution workflow, RFC process, issue triage, security policy, semantic versioning and release communication.
